entries.note: $ is read as USD; CAD and AUD are not distinguished
¥ is also used for CNY; treated as JPY, flagged ambiguous

rules: A currency token attaches to the nearest number on either side with no other word between, except that a single '.' after rs/रु is part of the word.
A number with no currency token has currency null, never a default.
Currency in source and target must have the same ISO code, or the fact is reported as CURRENCY_CHANGED.
